violations.description: HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): Chair noted directly in front of handsink in prep area -removed at this time. Handsink only to be used to wash hands items noted in sink also in need of cleaning. Disposable towels noted not provided in restrooms.

REFUSE STORAGE (1 pts): Exterior garbage containers noted not covered with tight fitting lids. (lids are up) Pile of branches by garbage containers need removal.
NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (1 pts): Shelving noted in need of cleaning.
